articles.title: Xbox Series X | X25 Special Edition Console – Invite Requests Are Up at Amazon
articles.summary: Back in August, when preorders went up for the translucent green Xbox Series X | X25 Special Edition console, they sold out almost instantly. That was a bummer for longtime Xbox fans who wanted to get their hands on one of these limited-edition 25th-anniversary consoles.
body: Requesting an invite doesn’t mean you’ll necessarily end up being invited to buy a console. But it gives you a chance to be invited, which is better than nothing. As Amazon says, “If invited to purchase, you’ll get an email when the item is available. Not all requests will be granted.”

The console is meant to celebrate the 25th anniversary of Xbox. It’s set to release on November 13 and costs (the curiously specific price) $909.23. Only 25,000 numbered consoles are being manufactured, which explains the difficulty people have had securing a preorder.

So what do you get if you do end up buying it? You get a 1TB Xbox Series X console, decked out in translucent green. The front of the console has an X25 logo, and when you turn it on, the X logo glows green as well. You also get a matching controller (which is also sold separately, and is still available at some retailers). Finally, you get a digital copy of Halo: Campaign Evolved, a remake of the campaign from the original Halo (see our review ).
points: Back in August, when preorders went up for the translucent green Xbox Series X | X25 Special Edition console, they sold out almost instantly.

articles.title: Dane Cook and Robert Bowling Announce Vicious Vocab, a Genre-Bending Word Game With a Big Twist
articles.summary: Ex-Call of Duty creative strategist Robert Bowling and comedian Dane Cook have revealed a brand new genre-bending video game known as Vicious Vocab, exclusively to IGN.
body: Vicious Vocab is a genre-bending spin on casual word games like Scrabble, Words With Friends, and Wordle, with a big twist. While Bowling and Cook are careful not to share much about the twist to preserve some surprises, the game goes well beyond mixing and matching letters to make new words. The words have power and meaning… and they can dramatically change not only what happens to you, but the entire genre of game that you’re playing.
Check out the trailer below to get an idea of the unexpected shift that happens in Vicious Vocab.

Made by a team of five people who collectively call themselves “funcool games,” Vicious Vocab is described as “Scrabble meets Balatro in a backroom casino.” On its own, it’s a fun twist on the word game genre. There’s an action element, which has led the team to referring to the game as a “word brawler” or, in Cook’s words, a first-person speller.

articles.title: Mass Effect Is Getting A New Art Collection At A Difficult Time For Its Fans
articles.summary: This year's annual Mass Effect Day looks to be somber in light of the studio behind the games, BioWare, being shut down last month. But while no new Mass Effect games are currently on the horizon, you can celebrate its legacy through some classy art prints that are going up for sale ahead of N7…
body: Moor-Art says it began collaborating with BioWare over a year ago to release a new selection of limited-edition posters. "What began as a celebration of an ongoing saga now feels like the bastion in the continuation of a studio's legacy," the studio said in a press release.

The collection from Moor-Art is inspired by the characters and worlds of Mass Effect, with the original artwork being produced by acclaimed artists and Mass Effect die-hard fans Matt Essom and Dan Mumford. The designs will also be available as T-shirts. The first one is by Essom, and Moor-Art says this illustration captures the spirit and emotional depth of the series, as well as the bonds forged on the Normandy as her crew traveled to unknown worlds. This will be limited to 200 hand-numbered prints worldwide, plus 30 Giclée prints with a certificate of authenticity signed by the artist.

articles.title: Ratchet & Clank Game Shutting Down Before Ever Fully Launching
articles.summary: Sony Interactive Entertainment and French developer Oh BiBi have announced Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble, a phone and tablet game, is coming to a close before it was even released fully.
body: In a statement, the developers said the game's final update is coming today, November 6, and the game itself will be removed from digital stores on November 21, 2026.

No information was provided as to why Ranger Rumble is shutting down. The game soft-launched in 2025 in limited territories, and expanded to more markets, but it's no longer going ahead with a full global release.

People who already have the game installed can keep playing until May 1, 2027, which is when the game's servers permanently close. Once the servers are shut down, the game will be completely unplayable.
Ranger Rumble is described as a "fast-paced multiplayer platformer arena shooter" where you battle others on a quest to become a galactic ranger.

articles.title: Bringing Bloodborne back is tricky because "there's a lot of involved rights associated," according to former PlayStation boss
articles.summary: Every year, Bloodborne fans pray for the birth of another game set in FromSoftware's Lovecraftian world. Every year, we're no closer to a Bloodborne 2 or even a Bloodborne Remastered. But why? PlayStation's former head honcho, Shawn Layden, blames it on the tricky situation of rights ownership.
body: Asked about the noticeable lack of Bloodborne in the decade since its blood moon shone down on us all, in an interview with The Trophy Room podcast, Layden explained that returning to any beloved game is tough.
"Bringing back old games has a certain challenge to it," he said. "Can you do something that is not only respectful of the original, but can you, you know, recreate the phenomenon as it were?"

Bloodborne's situation is slightly more complicated, though. It seems that the rights are somehow split between original publisher PlayStation, developer FromSoftware and the studio's primary stakeholder Kadokawa Corporation.

"There's a lot of involved rights associated with it, and in something like that - where Sony's in there and [FromSoftware] is in there and From's parent company is in there - I think just getting everyone to sign off on the same thing is probably the biggest challenge there," Layden said.
points: Every year, Bloodborne fans pray for the birth of another game set in FromSoftware's Lovecraftian world.
Every year, we're no closer to a Bloodborne 2 or even a Bloodborne Remastered.

articles.title: How to complete the Treasure Chest minigame in Zelda Ocarina of Time
articles.summary: The Treasure Chest minigame in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake will test how lucky you are as you choose between two chests. As this game is all about luck, it's kind of a scam, but there's one surefire way to make it to the end and claim the prize: the Lenses of Truth.
body: If you like to tempt fate, we can help you by explaining how to complete the Treasure Chest game in Zelda Ocarina of Time remake.

You can play the Treasure Chest game by visiting the Treasure-Chest Shop in Hyrule Castle Town. The shop is on the west side of the city, and it only opens at night, so use the Sun's Song, a bed, or just wait for a bit.

The Treasure Chest is a simple game: choose between two identical chests. If you open the one containing a key, you can proceed to the next room, where you will find two more chests. If you're lucky and find five keys in a row, you will earn a Piece of Heart. To play the game, you need to talk to the Treasure-Chest Shopkeeper and pay the 10-rupee entry fee. Once you complete the challenge, you can repeat it, but instead of earning a piece of heart, you will receive 20 rupees as the final reward.
points: The Treasure Chest minigame in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake will test how lucky you are as you choose between two chests.

articles.title: 'Godzilla Minus Zero' Officially Fixes King Ghidorah Canon in 1 Brilliant Way
articles.summary: In an interview with Polygon, the film's producer, Kazuaki Kishida, wouldn't say exactly how big the budget for Godzilla Minus Zero was (though it's been confirmed to be a significantly " more " than Minus One 's $15 million), but he did reveal one way that extra money changed how Yamazaki and his…
body: Godzilla Minus One was a primordial blast of pure kaiju energy, calling back to the 1954 original while pushing the limits of storytelling and special effects in the monster movie genre. So how did writer-director Takashi Yamazaki follow that up? By going even bigger with a direct sequel in Godzilla Minus Zero, which is playing now in theaters across the planet.

"With Godzilla Minus One, there were 35 artists working on the VFX," Kishida says. "With the additional resources, we had the option to scale that up a lot more, but we only increased it to about 50."

According to the producer, this choice directly reflects Yamazaki's style of filmmaking. He's not just the writer and director, he's also the VFX supervisor overseeing every piece of art created for the film. Keeping the team small allowed Yamazaki to retain that same level of quality control.

"He likes the idea of everyone being on the same floor," Kishida says. "He can just roll his chair around, take a look at different shots, give feedback, go to the next artist, etc. That exchange of ideas and that environment was very important to him."

articles.title: World of Warcraft: Forever hotfix puts a stop to super speedy flag carriers that were dominating PvP battlegrounds
articles.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever has received its first major hotfix patch, which among other things has put an end to an especially powerful bug that made PvP battlegrounds like Warsong Gulch favoured to the Horde's advantage.
body: While Taurens are running, they gradually build up stacks of increased movement speed. They gain a two percent movement speed bonus per stack, and it stacks up to 30 times. That means a Tauren can gain 60 percent increased movement speed, though it's worth noting that when they stop moving, these stacks decrease. In short, cows run fast.

The Hotfix, detailed in this Blizzard blog post, stops the Tauren's plainsrunning passive from stacking during a battleground's preparation phase. What players were doing to exploit this was running back and forth in the minutes before the Warsong Gulch battleground let both teams loose. It's a capture the flag game mode, so once the gates opened, Taurens were sprinting ahead of everyone else, allowing them to quickly push towards the enemy base for a potential early flag capture.

In addition, the hotfix removes any plainsrunning stacks from Taurens once they pick up the enemy flag, and prevents them from gaining stacks while the flag is in their possession. The goal of the enemy team is to stop and kill the enemy flag carrier as soon as possible, so a Tauren moving far faster than any of your team made this pretty difficult.

articles.title: It's hard to meet women when I keep teleporting all the time
articles.summary: Los Santos Customs. I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier. Am I cheating? I might be cheating.
body: Am I cheating? I might be cheating. I did not actually install a new mod for today's iteration of Los Santos Customs. Like I mentioned yesterday, updating my Script Hook thing seems to have breathed life into a host of old mods I'd installed, but which did not work. Now they work, and here we are.

I'm definitely not cheating on my wife though. I have a wife now, by the way, and all I had to do to get her was teleport her to the roof of a skyscraper and gift her 22 sports cars. No more lonely nights for me, and it's all thanks to Dating Simulator (Public Beta), a mod we probably shouldn't look too deep into in case it gets weird.

Dating Simulator—which refers to itself as Anoxic Dating in the in-game menus—brings the experience of real-life dating into GTA 5. You approach women on the street, ask them how they are 40 times, and then they give you their number. This makes you "Friends" according to the mod's hierarchy of romance, unlocking new, vaguely more intimate dialogue. Discuss the weather with your muse 50 times, then tell her you miss her 60 times and, brother, you're well on the way to wife town.
